visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a ceramic bowl containing dark buckwheat noodles topped with seaweed, seed powder, and a mountain of chopped green onions. A pair of hands holds a wooden spoon and chopsticks, beginning to mix the ingredients. The background is a clean, modern kitchen with a black countertop and white cabinetry under bright indoor lighting. (2) A woman with short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a red-bordered apron, sits at a wooden table in a sunlit room. She picks up a large portion of the noodles with her chopsticks and takes a bite, smiling broadly at the camera with squinted eyes. Large red and white text overlays the top and center of the frame. (3) The scene cuts to a close-up of the woman's hands holding a white and yellow retail package of 'Korean Perilla Oil Buckwheat Noodles'. She uses a pair of silver scissors to cut the package open, then pulls out and displays four individual sachets containing different seasonings and the raw noodles. (4) A white pot of boiling water is seen on an induction stove. The woman places the dry noodles into the water and stirs them with chopsticks. She holds up a pink digital timer showing 4 minutes and 30 seconds. Later, she pours cold water from a white mug into the pot. (5) The cooked noodles are drained into a metal strainer in a white sink. The woman's hands are shown rubbing and washing the noodles under a stream of cold tap water. The background features typical kitchen sink items like a drying rack and bowls. (6) In a fresh blue-patterned bowl, the woman pours yellow perilla oil and dark soy sauce from sachets. She adds the washed noodles and mixes them thoroughly with chopsticks. She then sprinkles the remaining toppings and green onions. The final phase shows her eating again, looking extremely satisfied.

The BGM is a bright, mid-tempo acoustic-pop track with acoustic guitar, light percussion, and a cheerful synth melody. (2) (SFX: Water bubbling) As the visual transition occurs, the female speaker adopts a friendly, instructional tone. She describes the Korean buckwheat noodles being prepared. The BGM maintains a steady, energetic rhythm at approximately 108 BPM. (3) (SFX: Metallic clinking, plastic rustling) The sound of kitchenware hitting the counter and plastic sachets being opened is clearly audible. The speaker lists the condiments included in the package with high clarity and a professional yet casual delivery style. (4) (SFX: Heavy water splash) A loud sound of water pouring into the sink accompanies the narrator's advice on washing the noodles. Her voice rises in pitch when emphasizing the word 'QQ' (chewy), indicating excitement. The BGM continues without interruption. (5) (SFX: Chopsticks stirring) The squelching sound of noodles being mixed with oil and sauce is heard. The narrator comments on the fragrance of the perilla oil with a very positive valence. A subtle 'ding' sound effect highlights the final preparation steps. (6) The audio concludes with a final slurp and a satisfied vocal reaction from the speaker. The BGM reaches a melodic resolution as the video ends, with the overall mix appearing very clean and professionally produced.

It uses a high-energy, friendly persona and fast-paced editing to make the preparation process look effortless and the result look delicious, catering to busy individuals looking for quick meal ideas.
